results.title: Ghana Medical Trust Fund courts US partners to expand cancer care
results.content: The Ghana Medical Trust Fund (GMTF) is seeking partnerships with American hospitals, investors and philanthropists to expand cancer treatment and other specialist healthcare services in Ghana.

results.content: Ghana is set to host a new cultural and entertainment event, Ghanival 2026, which will combine elements of Brazilian carnival with Ghanaian music, culture, fashion, food and dance. results.title: A call for support and solidarity with ministers from Volta Region amid incessant attacks by NPP
results.content: The incessant attacks on Ministers from the Volta Region by the New Patriotic Party (NPP) and sections of the media perceived as sympathetic to it are increasingly worrying.

results.title: Human rights lawyer couple sentenced to 10 years’ prison in Pakistan
results.content: A Pakistani anti-terrorism court has sentenced human rights lawyer Imaan Mazari and her husband Hadi Ali Chattha to 10 years in prison, over an alleged security breach during a cricket tour in 2024.

results.title: Absa introduces instant loans for eligible salaried customers
results.content: Absa Bank Ghana is expanding access to personal loans with its Instant Loans solution, allowing eligible salaried customers to borrow up to GH¢350,000 through the Bank’s digital banking platforms.

results.title: Minority caucus says rising utility bills are wiping out workers’ pay gains
results.content: The Minority in Parliament says rising electricity and water bills are wiping out public sector workers’ salary gains. It is demanding an immediate review of the 2027 and 2028 pay agreement.

results.title: Crypto giant Binance hit by $6.3bn hack suspected to be largest in history
results.content: Cryptocurrency giant Binance said on Thursday that $6.3bn (£4.7bn) in digital assets were affected by what is believed to be the biggest crypto hack on record.

results.content: Ampem Darkoa Ladies will once again be missing in action following their qualification for the 2026 CAF Women's Champions League after beating Edo Queens.

results.title: ‘Nothing short of an insult’ – Minority caucus condemns 9% pay rise
results.content: The Minority in Parliament has condemned the 9% pay rise agreed for public sector workers in 2027, calling it “nothing short of an insult” and demanding an immediate review.

results.title: Bono East Fire Command prioritises health with annual breast screening exercise
results.content: In a proactive move to promote the health and well-being of its personnel, the Bono East Regional Fire Command has held its annual breast screening exercise.

results.title: Akufo-Addo government fought anti-galamsey campaigners, not illegal mining – Sammy Gyamfi
results.content: The Chief Executive Officer of the Ghana Gold Board (GoldBod), Sammy Gyamfi, has criticised the former New Patriotic Party (NPP) administration over its handling of illegal mining, accusing it of targeting people who spoke out against the practice.

results.title: Minority caucus demands answers from organised labour over two-year pay deal
results.content: The Minority in Parliament is demanding that organised labour publish its wage proposals and explain why it accepted a two-year pay agreement starting with a 9% increase in 2027.

results.title: Ghana U-15 Boys finish FIFA U-15 World Cup & Festival on a high after 4-0 win over Colombia
results.content: Ghana had earlier lost 7-1 to Brazil in the Tier A Ranking Play-Offs (5th to 8th position) after exiting losing 7-6 on penalties to Paraguay following a 2-2 draw.

results.title: Beyond Degrees: New platform turns every Ghanaian skill into opportunity
results.content: For millions of young Ghanaians, the search for work has meant the same story: send the CV, wait, hear nothing, and wait again. Today, a new Ghanaian platform says the waiting can end. Sankofa Job, a national employment platform built by Ghanaian company G&T Prestige Ltd, launched today across all 16 regions of Ghana, with a simple message for every job seeker: don’t wait.

results.title: Motsepe defends two-year AFCON cycle, explains decision to shift to 2031 and 2033 editions
results.content: Confederation of African Football (CAF) president Dr Patrice Motsepe has defended the decision to maintain the Africa Cup of Nations (AFCON) on a two-year cycle, while explaining the reasons for the revised competition calendar beyond 2028.

results.title: Ghana’s AFCON U20 bid faces major stadium crisis as CAF flags venues
results.content: A CAF technical inspection report has identified significant infrastructure deficiencies at four of the five stadiums proposed by Ghana to host the 2027 Africa U20 Cup of Nations, with Baba Yara Sports Stadium declared non-compliant with the continent's Category 4 standards.

results.title: Galamsey fight will fail without mindset change — Young Dee Group CEO
results.content: Young Dee Group Chief Executive Officer Desmond Darko has urged Ghana’s leaders to address what he describes as the mindset driving illegal mining (galamsey), arguing that enforcement alone cannot end the menace.

results.title: AFCON back to every two years as CAF reverses decision
results.content: The Confederation of African Football (CAF) has reversed its decision to hold the Africa Cup of Nations every four years, restoring the tournament’s two-year cycle.

results.title: Minerals Commission tells Northern Ashanti Mines to fight lease termination in court, not media
results.content: The Minerals Commission has urged Northern Ashanti Mines Limited to pursue its legal challenge against the termination of its mining leases and prospecting licences in court rather than commenting publicly.

results.title: 2027 Budget to prioritise jobs, productivity and higher incomes – Nyarko Ampem
results.content: The government is expected to place job creation, increased productivity and economic growth at the centre of its 2027 Budget as it seeks to turn recent improvements in economic stability into tangible benefits for Ghanaians.

results.title: Mahama says social media criticism helps him become a better leader
results.content: President John Mahama has disclosed that social media platforms, including TikTok, help him pick up public complaints and feedback on government performance, which he forwards to ministers for attention.

results.title: ‘I see all your TikToks’ – Mahama says social media complaints reach him
results.content: President John Mahama says he monitors social media platforms, including TikTok, to track public concerns about his administration and ensure citizens' complaints reach the relevant ministers.

results.title: CAA, NFA, Copyright Ghana to lead dialogue on creatives’ pension scheme
results.content: The Creative Arts Agency (CAA), National Film Authority (NFA) and Copyright Ghana will lead stakeholder discussions on a sustainable pension and social security programme for Ghanaian creative professionals.

results.title: Namibia President urges Africa to harness natural resources, youth for global influence
results.content: Namibian President Netumbo Nandi-Ndaitwah says Africa must harness its vast natural resources and youthful population to strengthen its economic power and influence global decisions, rather than allow others to determine the continent’s future.

results.title: Fuel spill nearly blinded me while working at Shell — Young Dee Group CEO
results.content: Young Dee Group Chief Executive Officer Desmond Darko has recounted a frightening accident during his days as a fuel attendant at Shell, when petrol splashed into his eyes, leaving him struggling to see.

results.title: Titus Glover urges Ga chiefs to defend traders affected by La Pleasure Beach demolition
results.content: The National Organiser of the New Patriotic Party (NPP), Titus Glover, has called on traditional authorities in the Greater Accra Region to intervene in the demolition of traders’ stalls at La Pleasure Beach, saying their silence over issues affecting their communities is worrying.
